INSERT INTO analitica_diaria (fecha, distrito, parametro, promedio, maximo, minimo,
                              n_mediciones, n_estaciones, horas_con_dato, limite_eca, excede_eca)
SELECT (m.medido_en AT TIME ZONE 'America/Lima')::date, e.zona, m.parametro,
       AVG(m.valor), MAX(m.valor), MIN(m.valor), COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT e.id),
       COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('hour', m.medido_en)), l.limite,
       (AVG(m.valor) > l.limite)
FROM mediciones_aire m
JOIN estaciones e ON e.id = m.estacion_id
JOIN (VALUES ('pm25', 50.0), ('pm10', 100.0)) AS l(parametro, limite) ON l.parametro = m.parametro
WHERE m.valor IS NOT NULL AND m.unidad = 'µg/m³' AND e.zona IS NOT NULL
  AND m.medido_en >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Lima') - interval '3 days') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Lima'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,l.limite
ON CONFLICT (fecha, distrito, parametro) DO UPDATE SET
  promedio = EXCLUDED.promedio, maximo = EXCLUDED.maximo, minimo = EXCLUDED.minimo,
  n_mediciones = EXCLUDED.n_mediciones, n_estaciones = EXCLUDED.n_estaciones,
  horas_con_dato = EXCLUDED.horas_con_dato, excede_eca = EXCLUDED.excede_eca,
  calculado_en = now()
RETURNING fecha, distrito, parametro, excede_eca;

WITH sem AS (
  SELECT (date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Lima')::date - 7) AS ini
),
d AS (
  SELECT fecha, parametro, promedio, maximo, excede_eca,
         regexp_replace(translate(lower(distrito), 'áéíóúüñ', 'aeiouun'), '[^a-z0-9]+', '-', 'g') AS id
  FROM analitica_diaria
)
SELECT sem.ini::text AS semana_inicio, d.id, d.parametro,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.fecha >= sem.ini)                          AS dias,
       AVG(d.promedio) FILTER (WHERE d.fecha >= sem.ini)                   AS promedio,
       MAX(d.maximo) FILTER (WHERE d.fecha >= sem.ini)                     AS maximo,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.fecha >= sem.ini AND d.excede_eca)         AS excedidos,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.fecha < sem.ini)                           AS dias_anterior,
       AVG(d.promedio) FILTER (WHERE d.fecha < sem.ini)                    AS anterior
FROM d, sem
WHERE d.fecha >= sem.ini - 7 AND d.fecha <= sem.ini + 6
GROUP BY sem.ini, d.id, d.parametro
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.fecha >= sem.ini) > 0
ORDER BY d.id, d.parametro;

INSERT INTO analitica_insights (semana_inicio, distrito, resumen, modelo)
VALUES ($1::date, $2, $3, $4)
ON CONFLICT (semana_inicio, distrito) DO UPDATE SET
  resumen = EXCLUDED.resumen, modelo = EXCLUDED.modelo, generado_en = now()
RETURNING semana_inicio, distrito, modelo;

WITH fin AS (
  SELECT MAX(fecha) AS hasta FROM analitica_diaria
),
d AS (
  SELECT fecha, parametro, promedio, maximo, excede_eca,
         regexp_replace(translate(lower(distrito), 'áéíóúüñ', 'aeiouun'), '[^a-z0-9]+', '-', 'g') AS id
  FROM analitica_diaria
),
sel AS (
  SELECT d.* FROM d, fin
  WHERE d.id = ANY(string_to_array($1, ','))
    AND d.parametro = ANY(string_to_array($2, ','))
    AND d.fecha > fin.hasta - ($3::int * 2)
    AND d.fecha <= fin.hasta
),
ult AS (
  SELECT id, MAX(fecha) AS ultimo FROM d
  WHERE id = ANY(string_to_array($1, ',')) GROUP BY id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT hasta FROM fin)::text AS hasta,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
      'fecha', fecha::text, 'id', id, 'parametro', parametro,
      'promedio', promedio, 'maximo', maximo, 'excede', excede_eca) ORDER BY fecha) FROM sel), '[]'::json) AS filas,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'ultimo', ultimo::text)) FROM ult), '[]'::json) AS ultimos;

WITH fin AS (
  SELECT MAX(fecha) AS hasta FROM analitica_diaria
),
t AS (
  SELECT regexp_replace(translate(lower(distrito), 'áéíóúüñ', 'aeiouun'), '[^a-z0-9]+', '-', 'g') AS id,
         fecha, promedio, maximo, excede_eca
  FROM analitica_diaria
  WHERE parametro = $1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT hasta FROM fin)::text AS hasta,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
    SELECT t.id,
           COUNT(*)                              AS dias_con_dato,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.excede_eca)  AS dias_excedidos,
           AVG(t.promedio)                       AS promedio,
           MAX(t.maximo)                         AS maximo
    FROM t, fin
    WHERE t.fecha > fin.hasta - $2::int AND t.fecha <= fin.hasta
    GROUP BY t.id
  ) x), '[]'::json) AS filas;

WITH fin AS (
  SELECT MAX(fecha) AS hasta FROM analitica_diaria
)
SELECT
  (SELECT hasta FROM fin)::text AS hasta,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.hora) FROM (
    SELECT extract(hour FROM m.medido_en AT TIME ZONE 'America/Lima')::int AS hora,
           AVG(m.valor) AS promedio, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM mediciones_aire m
    JOIN estaciones e ON e.id = m.estacion_id, fin
    WHERE regexp_replace(translate(lower(e.zona), 'áéíóúüñ', 'aeiouun'), '[^a-z0-9]+', '-', 'g') = $1
      AND m.parametro = $2 AND m.unidad = 'µg/m³' AND m.valor IS NOT NULL
      AND m.medido_en >= ((fin.hasta - ($3::int - 1))::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Lima')
      AND m.medido_en <  ((fin.hasta + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Lima')
    GROUP BY 1
  ) x), '[]'::json) AS horas;

SELECT semana_inicio::text AS semana_inicio, resumen, modelo,
       to_char(generado_en AT TIME ZONE 'America/Lima', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') || '-05:00' AS generado_en
FROM analitica_insights
WHERE distrito = $1
ORDER BY semana_inicio DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH fin AS (
  SELECT MAX(fecha) AS hasta FROM analitica_diaria
),
d AS (
  SELECT fecha, regexp_replace(translate(lower(distrito), 'áéíóúüñ', 'aeiouun'), '[^a-z0-9]+', '-', 'g') AS id
  FROM analitica_diaria
)
SELECT
  (SELECT hasta FROM fin)::text AS hasta,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.id) FROM (
    SELECT d.id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT d.fecha)                                          AS dias_con_dato,
           MIN(d.fecha)::text                                               AS primer,
           MAX(d.fecha)::text                                               AS ultimo,
           COUNT(DISTINCT d.fecha) FILTER (WHERE d.fecha > fin.hasta - 7)   AS d7,
           COUNT(DISTINCT d.fecha) FILTER (WHERE d.fecha > fin.hasta - 30)  AS d30
    FROM d, fin
    GROUP BY d.id
  ) x), '[]'::json) AS filas;
